The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2025-2026

content_blocks.text: This annual competition has been established in memory of Rosie Choueka, a committed and hard-working member of the PLA’s Executive Committee who sadly passed away in 2015 following a valiant fight against breast cancer.
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2025-2026

content_blocks.text: Rosie had a passion for public procurement law which the PLA aims to honour by encouraging young lawyers (students, solicitors and barristers (or national equivalents) up to and including three (3) years post qualification status) to submit an essay of not less than 2000 words and not more than 3000 words on different public procurement subjects. This year the chosen topic is:
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2025-2026

content_blocks.text: “Is public procurement the right vehicle for delivery of social value – what are the pros and cons?”
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2025-2026

content_blocks.text: The essay should be submitted to the PLA by no later than 5pm on Friday 5 th June 2026 via email to Dr Rebecca Rees at Trowers & Hamlins LLP ( rrees@trowers.com ).
heading_path: The Rosie Choueka Memorial Essay Prize 2025-2026

content_blocks.text: We are pleased to announce that the following prizes will be available for the winning essays:
